// Test-only overlay on the pinned corresponding source; never a production daemon.
package player

import (
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/output"
	"io"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type coreSentinel struct {
	value float32
	title string
}

func (s *coreSentinel) Read(p []float32) (int, error) {
	for i := range p {
		p[i] = s.value
	}
	return len(p), nil
}
func (s *coreSentinel) SetPositionMs(int64) error { s.value = .5; return nil }
func (*coreSentinel) PositionMs() int64           { return 0 }
func (s *coreSentinel) FramedIdentity() string {
	return `{"uri":"spotify:track:fixture","title":"` + s.title + `"}`
}
func TestCoreConsumerFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
	s := NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(&coreSentinel{.25, "first"})
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Drop(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = s.SetPositionMs(12000); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	if e = out.Drop(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s.SetPrimary(&coreSentinel{.75, "second"})
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
}

type coreFinite struct {
	coreSentinel
	remaining int
}

func (s *coreFinite) Read(p []float32) (int, error) {
	n := len(p)
	if n > s.remaining*2 {
		n = s.remaining * 2
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		p[i] = s.value
	}
	s.remaining -= n / 2
	if s.remaining == 0 {
		return n, io.EOF
	}
	return n, nil
}
func TestCorePrefetchFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
	s := NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(&coreFinite{coreSentinel{.25, "first"}, 4411})
	s.SetSecondary(&coreFinite{coreSentinel{.75, "second"}, 8819})
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
}

func TestCoreSustainedFixture(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
	s := NewSwitchingAudioSource(0)
	s.SetPrimary(&coreSentinel{.25, "sustained"})
	out, e := output.NewOutput(&output.NewOutputOptions{Backend: "framed", Reader: s, OutputPipe: path, SampleRate: 44100, ChannelCount: 2, ExternalVolume: true, VolumeUpdate: make(chan float32, 1)})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	if e = out.Resume(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
}
